newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 74.2 bln marks in tender at 3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 74.2 bln marks in tender at 3 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday it allocated 74.2 billion marks of securities repurchase funds at this week's tender at a fixed three percent rate, the rate that has prevailed since late August.
A repo pact for 74.0 billion marks expires today, Wednesday, so a net 200 million marks is flowing into the money market.
The central bank said banks bid for 228.3 billion marks for the 14-day funds and that it accepted 32.5 percent of the bids made.
